deviations.from: D-39 (categories come from the contracts list)
deviations.proposal: The importers emit 7 categories missing from @smart-finances/contracts CATEGORIES: Interest and Refunds (mercadopago.mjs categoryFor), Shopping (mercadopago.mjs), Income, Loans and Transfers (notion.mjs), Pets (excel.mjs SHEET_CATEGORIES). The SF-46 test "fails when an importer emits a category not in it" therefore fails. Recommended: add the 7 to packages/contracts/src/categories.mjs before Uncategorized (which stays last), then add the test. Changing the importers instead would change the local import output (AC-20).

surprises: SF-40: web tests that walk src/ (T-WEB-9, T-WSCR-14) race with tests that write and delete temp fixtures there (zz_fixture.ts, zz_dep.ts). Pre-existing; not in this PR's files.

SF-43: POST /totals/rebuild is also refused with conflict in the erase window (D-30 lists totals among refused work); test/fixtures/http.mjs added as a shared test helper (outside the task's Files, test-only).

SF-45: PUT /rates/{month} is refused with conflict in the erase window (its put carries the erase check), so a late rate cannot outlive delete-all. missing_rates is filled in both views (months with pesos and no rate), as the web reads it from the native view. In the usd view, currencies other than ARS and USD stay out (no rate exists for them).
SF-46: PUT review is one transaction with the erase check and a check that the row exists, so a choice cannot outlive delete-all.

SF-47: toCsv guards only free-text columns, so the export also guards id, date, date_precision, kind, currency, source, country and import_batch (Values: every field except amount); allRows added to store/query.mjs and reused by review.mjs (files beyond SF-47's list).

SF-48: the erase writes ERASED before checking for live locks and open forms, and puts the marker back if it must refuse, so a lock taken between the check and the mark cannot happen. Files beyond SF-48's list: keys.mjs (uploadPrefix), write.mjs (POST /imports, undo and repair check the window first; closes PR 2 conformance minor 2), store.test.mjs (T-KEY-1 pins the new export). api-delete needs PutItem for the ERASED marker and GetItem, beyond architecture's 'table read and delete'.
infra/test/stacks.test.ts (T-INF-6, outside SF-50 Files) pins the API's SSM names; the planned sixth value table-stream-arn changed it by one line.

Grants beyond the architecture text: api-delete holds dynamodb:PutItem (it puts and checks the erase marker); the stream source adds sqs:SendMessage, GetQueueAttributes and GetQueueUrl on the failure queue to the rollup role.
